request.style: English, male solo voice, warm and intimate, piano, acoustic guitar, cello, soft strings, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
In the cold Roman cell I wait
Winter comes before the day is done
The world has turned its face away
But I have kept the faith

[Chorus]
Eubulus sends you greetings
And so do Pudens and Linus
Claudia and all the brothers
Greeting you from Rome

[Verse]
Demas has gone to Thessalonica
Crescens has gone to Galatia
Only Luke remains with me
Bring Mark for service

[Chorus]
Eubulus sends you greetings
And so do Pudens and Linus
Claudia and all the brothers
Greeting you from Rome

[Bridge]
At my first defense no one stood by me
Everyone abandoned me
But the Lord stood by me
And gave me strength to speak

[Outro]
Do your best to come before winter
Eubulus sends you greetings
